gaps.title: Corporate Authentication and Session Management
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the system, I want to authenticate using my corporate credentials or login/password, so that my identity is verified and my role permissions are enforced securely.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated user, When they provide valid login credentials, Then the system issues a secure session token rather than trusting unverified HTTP headers.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'авторизация через корпоративную учётную запись или по логину/паролю'

gaps.title: Database Persistence for Comments and Actualization Requests
gaps.jtbd: When viewing or reviewing a document, I want to submit comments and update requests, so that my feedback is stored persistently and content managers are notified.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a document view, When a user submits a comment or update request, Then the data is written to persistent database storage instead of being stored only in ephemeral in-memory maps.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'возможность комментирования и отправки запросов на актуализацию'

gaps.title: Update Date and Education Level Backend Search Filters
gaps.jtbd: When searching for documents, I want to filter by update date and education level on the backend, so that only relevant files are queried and returned.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search or document list query, When the user applies update date or education level filters, Then the backend queries the database using these criteria rather than relying on frontend-only simulation.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'фильтры по типу документа, специальности, уровню образования, дате обновления'

gaps.title: Document File Storage and Download Endpoints
gaps.jtbd: When uploading a new document version, I want the system to persist the file contents and provide a download URL, so that users can view and download the actual materials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a document upload request, When a file is uploaded, Then the server stores the actual file contents on disk or cloud storage and exposes a functional retrieval endpoint at the generated URL.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Any knowledge base supporting file uploads must persist the files and expose endpoints to retrieve them.
